title: A comparison of passive airDNA collection and extraction methods on the recovered terrestrial vertebrate assemblage SRA data
description: SRA data for the publication titled above. Sequencing files are from an Illumina Novaseq X Platform using both the Mamm02 and V12S-U primers, where first letter outlines each kit respectively (i.e., M_X_X_01, V_X_X_01). Four extraction kits are used, Blood & Tissue, MagMAX, Powersoil and Quick-DNA Miniprep Plus (Zymo), outlined by the second letter (i.e., X_B_X_01, X_M_X_01, X_P_X_01, X_Z_X_01). Two filter types are used, medical gauze (cloth) and paraffin gauze (i.e., X_X_C_01, X_X_P_01). The unique filter number is then outlined by the number (i.e., X_X_X_01).
